items.body: The plan requires timeout reset to commit a history transition while preserving the transition ceiling. Existing `commitTransitionLocked` rejects when history is full (`simulation_network.go:958–962`). A successful held write can consume the last slot before expiry. With no active application I/O, rejecting the reset leaves endpoints and retained bytes stalled indefinitely; resetting without recording violates R7. The plan specifies neither admission protection nor an observable terminal disposition for this case.
items.suggestion: Define how timeout work remains commit-capable within the history bound, including competing operations consuming remaining slots. Add both-backend coverage where a returned held write reaches history capacity before expiry.
items.title: The plan requires timeout reset to commit a history transition while preserving the transition ceiling

items.body: Task 7 requires new dial-stall cases to pass in both backends, but its command launches tests directly through the toolchain wrapper. Process cases skip without Runner transport; unguarded process execution returns `ErrBackendUnavailable` (`cluster.go:111–112`). Runner uses an explicit test-name list, and task 10 alone owns registering the new cases. Task 10 transitively depends on task 7. Consequently, task 7’s stated scope and commands cannot establish its process acceptance before the dependent registration work.
items.suggestion: Make Runner registration and execution available before the corresponding both-backend acceptance, or explicitly place that acceptance at the later integration gate. Preserve evidence that process cases execute without skipping.
